mn145:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn145:1.3: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā puṇṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn145:2.1: sādhu maṃ bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena ovādena ovadatu, ‘yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyya’nti.
mn145:2.2: tena hi puṇṇa, suṇohi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn145:2.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā puṇṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
mn145:3.1: santi kho puṇṇa, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn145:3.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati, abhivadati, ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn145:3.3: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi,
mn145:3.9: manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn145:3.10: taṃ ce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn145:3.11: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi.
mn145:4.1: santi kho puṇṇa, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
mn145:4.2: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati. nābhivadati. nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn145:4.3: tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati.
mn145:4.9: manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn145:4.10: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati, nābhivadati, nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn145:4.11: tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandī nirujjhati.
mn145:5.1: iminā ca tvaṃ puṇṇa, mayā saṅkhittena ovādena ovadito katarasmiṃ janapade viharissasīti.
mn145:5.2: imināhaṃ bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena ovādena ovadito atthi suṇāparanto nāma janapado tatthāhaṃ viharissāmi.
mn145:5.5: sace taṃ puṇṇa, suṇāparantakā manussā akkosissanti paribhāsissanti, tattha te puṇṇa kinti bhavissatī’ti.
mn145:5.6: sace maṃ bhante, suṇāparantakā manussā akkosissanti. paribhāsissanti, tattha me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.7: ‘bhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā. yaṃ me nayime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī’ti.
mn145:5.10: sace pana te puṇṇa, suṇāparantakā manussā pāṇinā pahāraṃ dassanti, tattha pana te puṇṇa, kinti bhavissatī’ti.
mn145:5.11: sace me bhante, suṇāparantakā manussā pāṇinā pahāraṃ dassanti. tattha me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.12: ‘bhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me nayime leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dentī’ti.
mn145:5.15: sace pana te puṇṇa, suṇāparantakā manussā leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dassanti. tattha pana te puṇṇa, kinti bhavissatī’ti.
mn145:5.16: sace me bhante, suṇāparantakā manussā leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dassanti, tattha me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.17: ‘bhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me nayime daṇḍena pahāraṃ dentī’ti.
mn145:5.20: sace pana te puṇṇa, suṇāparantakā manussā daṇḍena pahāraṃ dassanti. tattha pana te puṇṇa, kinti bhavissatī’ti.
mn145:5.21: ‘sace pana me bhante, suṇāparantakā manussā daṇḍena pahāraṃ dassanti. tattha me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.22: bhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me nayime satthena pahāraṃ dentī’ti.
mn145:5.25: sace pana te puṇṇa, suṇāparantakā manussā satthena pahāraṃ dassanti. tattha pana te puṇṇa, kinti bhavissatī’ti.
mn145:5.26: ‘sace me bhante suṇāparantakā manussā satthena pahāraṃ dassanti. tattha me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.27: ‘bhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vatime suṇāparantakā manussā, yaṃ maṃ nayime tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropenti.
mn145:5.30: sace pana taṃ puṇṇa, suṇāparantakā manussā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropessanti. tattha pana te puṇṇa, kinti bhavissatī’ti.
mn145:5.31: sace maṃ bhante, suṇāparantakā manussā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropenti. tattha pana me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.32: santi kho bhagavato sāvakā kāyena ca jīvitena ca aṭṭiyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā satthahārakaṃ pariyesanti. taṃ me idaṃ apariyiṭṭhaṃyeva satthahārakaṃ laddhanti.
mn145:6.2: sakkhissasi kho tvaṃ puṇṇa, iminā damūpasamena samannāgato suṇāparantasmiṃ janapade viharituṃ.
mn145:7.1: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena suṇāparanto janapado, tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
mn145:7.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena suṇāparanto janapado, tadavasari.
mn145:7.3: tatra sudaṃ āyasmā puṇṇo suṇāparantasmiṃ janapade viharati.
mn145:7.4: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo tenevantaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭipādesi. tenevantara vassena pañcamattāni upāsikāsatāni paṭipādesi. tenevantaravassena tisso vijjā sacchākāsi.
mn145:7.5: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo aparena samayena parinibbāyi.
mn145:8.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn145:8.2: yo so bhante, puṇṇo nāma kulaputto bhagavatā saṅkhittena ovādena ovadito, so kālaṅkato.
mn145:8.4: paṇḍito bhikkhave, puṇṇo kulaputto, paccapādī dhammassānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ viheṭhesi.
mn145:8.7: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
